description: Optional adapter for Claude Code (Mission Pipeline 4.4 works without it): at session start, print a neutral pointer (the PM reads the core of its handbook and runs mp pm session; a seat follows its card) and run nothing; on a prompt in the PM's session, remind the PM about message types and deferred recording; it records nothing and is silent when MP_SECRETARY is set. It acts only in a project with .mission-pipeline/ and never blocks a prompt.
